beats.label: S1 · Wedding raid
beats.text: Lucy MacLean's arranged wedding in Vault 33 is a raider ambush by Lee Moldaver, who abducts her father Hank; Lucy defies Vault law and heads to the surface to find him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Lucy's entire journey and puts Hank in enemy hands — the engine of the season.

beats.label: S1 · Maximus takes the armor
beats.text: Brotherhood squire Maximus lets his abusive knight bleed out and steals his power armor, then joins the hunt for a fugitive Enclave scientist carrying a mystery target.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains how a squire ends up in armor chasing the same MacGuffin as Lucy.

beats.label: S1 · Cooper's wife
beats.text: In pre-war flashbacks, Vault-Tec spokesman Cooper Howard — the man who becomes the Ghoul — learns his wife Barb is a top executive plotting to profit from nuclear war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ties the Ghoul to the Vault-Tec conspiracy and seeds the pre-war throughline that continues into S2.

beats.label: S1 · Lucy and the Ghoul
beats.text: Lucy falls in with the Ghoul, an irradiated bounty hunter, and the two escort scientist Wilzig's severed head — the currency Moldaver demands for Hank — across the wasteland.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the show's central pairing and the object that drives every faction's movement.

beats.label: S1 · Vault 31's secret
beats.text: Lucy's brother Norm discovers Vault 31 holds cryogenically preserved Vault-Tec executives run by Bud Askins' cyborg brain, and that every overseer of Vaults 32 and 33 came from it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the underground faction that quietly controls the vaults and traps Norm inside it going into S2.

beats.label: S1 · What Hank did
beats.text: Moldaver reveals Hank himself nuked Shady Sands and turned Lucy's mother into a feral ghoul; Lucy hands over the head, and Moldaver activates cold fusion before dying.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Breaks Lucy's belief in her father and puts cold fusion in play as the season's exiting prize.

beats.label: S1 · The road to New Vegas
beats.text: Lucy mercy-kills her ghoulified mother and disowns Hank, who escapes east toward New Vegas; she leaves with the Ghoul and Dogmeat to hunt down Vault-Tec's true leaders.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the destination, alliances, and personal stakes the entire second season is built around.

cliffhanger.text: Lucy leaves the ruins of Los Angeles with the Ghoul and Dogmeat, chasing Hank across the wasteland toward New Vegas, while Norm is trapped underground with the frozen executives who really run the vaults.
questions: Why did Hank destroy Shady Sands?
What does Bud Askins want with Norm now that he knows?
What is waiting for Lucy in New Vegas?

characters.name: Lucy MacLean
characters.line: Vault 33 dweller who left home to find her father and is now traveling the wasteland with the Ghoul to hunt down Vault-Tec's leadership.

characters.name: The Ghoul / Cooper Howard
characters.line: Pre-war movie star turned irradiated bounty hunter, uneasy ally to Lucy and pursuing his own long-buried grudge against Vault-Tec.

characters.name: Hank MacLean
characters.line: Lucy's father, exposed as the man who nuked Shady Sands; escaped Los Angeles for New Vegas at the end of the season.

characters.name: Maximus
characters.line: Brotherhood squire who murdered his knight for the armor, was forgiven, and is now hailed as Knight Maximus after helping crush Moldaver's cell.

characters.name: Norm MacLean
characters.line: Lucy's cautious brother, trapped inside Vault 31 after uncovering that its overseers are all cryogenically preserved Vault-Tec executives.

characters.name: Bud Askins
characters.line: Pre-war Vault-Tec exec now surviving as a cyborg brain inside Vault 31, quietly running the vaults through his frozen colleagues.

characters.name: Lee Moldaver
characters.line: Cold fusion scientist turned raider leader; switched Los Angeles's power back on before dying, having exposed Hank and Vault-Tec to Lucy.

beats.label: S2 · Chip-controlled puppets
beats.text: Chasing Hank, Lucy and the Ghoul find Vault-Tec's brainwashing experiment in Vault 24 — victims implanted with chips that hijack their bodies and detonate their heads on command.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the control-chip technology that turns out to be Hank's whole life's work this season.

beats.label: S2 · Norm springs the vault
beats.text: Trapped and starving in Vault 31, Norm revives the cryogenically preserved Vault-Tec executives and cons them into leading themselves out to the surface as a supposed test.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Vault-Tec's original architects back into the world and gives Norm his own storyline outside the vaults.

beats.label: S2 · Who nuked Shady Sands
beats.text: Flashbacks reveal Hank was the architect of Shady Sands' destruction, using a chip-controlled trader to smuggle a nuclear bomb into the city in 2283.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns S1's biggest reveal into an active war crime with a method, motive, and future pattern.

beats.label: S2 · Brotherhood fractures
beats.text: The Brotherhood's plan for civil war collapses when Commonwealth envoy Harkness arrives; Maximus kills him and flees Area 51 with the cold fusion relic and Thaddeus.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits the Brotherhood in two and puts Maximus back on the road with the season's most valuable object.

beats.label: S2 · Barb was the architect
beats.text: Pre-war, Cooper discovers Barb, not he, engineered dropping the bombs first; she extracts a cold fusion device from Hank, and Cooper is arrested taking her blame for the Enclave.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rewrites the Vault-Tec conspiracy around Barb and finally explains Cooper's disappearance from history.

beats.label: S2 · House on the monitor
beats.text: The Ghoul admits he means to trade Lucy to Hank for word on his family; Lucy impales him and is captured, and in the Lucky 38 the Ghoul later meets RobCo's Robert House alive on a monitor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ruptures Lucy and the Ghoul's alliance and reveals the pre-war titan who has been quietly waiting behind New Vegas.

beats.label: S2 · Phase 2 begins
beats.text: Lucy chip-implants Hank, who wipes his own memory; Steph triggers Enclave Phase 2 from Vault 32, and the Ghoul finds his family's cryo-pods empty with a clue pointing to Colorado.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Neutralises Hank, activates the Enclave from inside the vaults, and sends the Ghoul east — all the threads S3 opens on.

cliffhanger.text: Four factions converge on New Vegas: the Legion marches on the Strip under a new Caesar, the Enclave has activated Phase 2 from inside Vault 32, RobCo's Robert House is revealed alive in the Lucky 38, and the Brotherhood's Quintus now holds Liberty Prime blueprints.
questions: What is Enclave Phase 2, and how does Steph fit in?
Whose side will Robert House take now that he is out in the open?
What is left of the Ghoul's family in Colorado?

characters.name: Lucy MacLean
characters.line: Has captured and chipped Hank and is reunited with Maximus on the Strip as the Legion arrives at the gates.

characters.name: The Ghoul / Cooper Howard
characters.line: Betrayed and forgave Lucy, allied with Maximus, and is now chasing a fresh clue toward his family in Colorado.

characters.name: Hank MacLean
characters.line: His crimes and Enclave loyalty exposed, then wiped from his own memory by the control chip Lucy planted.

characters.name: Maximus
characters.line: Fugitive Brotherhood knight who killed Harkness and fled Area 51 with the cold fusion relic; rescued by the NCR on the Strip.

characters.name: Norm MacLean
characters.line: Bruised survivor of the radroach massacre at Vault-Tec HQ, alive with executive Claudia after Ronnie tried to kill him.

characters.name: Robert House
characters.line: RobCo Industries founder, revealed alive inside the Lucky 38 and plotting to use cold fusion to survive indefinitely.

characters.name: Steph
characters.line: Vault 32 overseer secretly a Canadian survivor and Enclave agent; used a Pip-Boy from Hank's box to activate Phase 2.

characters.name: Elder Quintus
characters.line: Brotherhood Elder betrayed by Maximus, now holding the Liberty Prime blueprints Dane retrieved for him.

characters.name: Lacerta Legate
characters.line: The self-proclaimed new Caesar who unified the fractured Legion and is leading it into New Vegas.
